plan.clustering: Phi Algorithm 1 inspired weighted binary Hamming k-means. Exclude all-zero and one-hot input rows. Seed 1701; weighted random distinct-support initialization; maximum 30 iterations; mean exactly 0.5 rounds to zero; empty clusters retain their previous centers. This is an independently specified calibration, not the official Phi artifact or fine-tuning.
plan.assignment: Minimum Hamming distance. Equal distance uses lowest base mask; no base if it cannot strictly reduce the original number of source terms. Zero/one-hot input rows use ordinary bypass.
plan.streaming: Native row order, cache starts cold per tile. One shared LRU wide-value budget for base and residual objects. Only completed resident results match. Fixed base graph compiled offline; on a missing compiled parent construct requested base directly, without recursive replays. Signed residual parent requires same-sign subset. Admit all computed residuals of length at least two. Hold base and residual in two explicit join/compute vector registers outside the shared cache.
variants: precomputed PWP fetch with cache, independent L2
same base graph plus exact residual cache
same base graph plus completed-residual subset cache
plan.counting: Separate vector additions, source-weight reads, signed source negations, wide PWP external requests, shared-cache reads/writes/evictions and original destination commits. No sum reported as time or energy. Phi parallel eight-input reduction and PWP prefetch require a later cycle comparator; these are operation and request counts only.
plan.scope: Calibration/evaluation are disjoint sample IDs from one frozen sequence ledger; not a cross-sequence generalization result. No checkpoint changes, no RTL/PPA, no AEE. All functional checks use exact diagnostic rational theta and signed weights, not frozen floating-point execution.

resolved_plan_details.rng: Seed 1701 reset independently for every operator/K/requested-q model.
resolved_plan_details.duplicate_centers: Merge and sort after every update; actual center count may shrink.
resolved_plan_details.base_graph: Largest nonzero proper-subset center; ties smallest numeric mask; no virtual bases; nonresident parent means direct current-base construction.
resolved_plan_details.cache_keys: Separate base and residual object types, one shared LRU capacity. R key=(positive_mask,negative_mask), independent of base. No cross-type aliases.
resolved_plan_details.lru: Only actual value reads and new writes update recency; tag lookups and failed subset comparisons do not. New entries evict the least recently used completed value.
resolved_plan_details.residual_parent_tie: Largest resident same-sign subset, ties lexicographic (positive_mask,negative_mask); exact hit is checked first.
resolved_plan_details.independent_l2: Construct delta from zero then join base; first operand assignment free but read/negation charged. No persistent residual admission in independent-L2 variants.
resolved_plan_details.unassigned_rows: Nontrivial unassigned rows use base=0 and delta=S; residual variants may cache/reuse these R objects.
resolved_plan_details.zero_and_singletons: Original zero/one-hot rows bypass. One-hot centers use one raw weight read in every variant; zero centers use constant zero. Neither becomes a cache object or external PWP request.
resolved_plan_details.registers: Exactly two reserved vector registers outside cache: base/join, then residual/compute. Base first; its copied value survives any subsequent cache eviction.
resolved_plan_details.admission: Cache every fetched/computed nontrivial base. Cache every newly computed residual of length >=2 only in residual variants; exact hits do not rewrite.
resolved_plan_details.weight_formula: Eight lanes: (((c+3)*(h+5)*13)%256)-128; overwrite lane0=-128 and lane1=127 to exercise range extremes.
resolved_plan_details.threshold_formula: theta_c=(999883+17*c)/1000000; numerator arithmetic in int64, with common denominator 1000000.
resolved_plan_details.auxiliary_metadata: Origin base in cached R entries is audit-only provenance and never affects selection, replacement, or arithmetic.
resolved_plan_details.pwp_scope: PWP values precomputed externally only for the first variant. Report their runtime requests and separate offline full-center build arithmetic. Unique touched nontrivial bases are also reported as a per-tile prefetch lower bound, not as measured traffic.
resolved_plan_details.calibration_sweep_order: operator, K partition, requested q; the same calibrated centers and row assignment are supplied to every variant/capacity.

variant_labels.pwp_independent_l2: precomputed PWP fetch with cache, independent L2
variant_labels.ondemand_base_exact_residual: same base graph plus exact residual cache

state_contract.cache_initialization: cold per variant per evaluation tile
state_contract.wide_value_unit: one complete diagnostic vector; not a mapped SRAM word or iso-area proof
state_contract.numeric_reference: Full Y for every original row, not residual-only equality

limits: No RTL, EDA, physical SRAM admission, full-network speed, or AEE claim.
Operation/request counts do not model Phi eight-input parallel reduction, PWP prefetch scheduling, memory-word widths, ports, pipeline stalls, or cycle latency.
Clustering follows the predeclared independent calibration, not the official Phi artifact; all settings are fixed before evaluating held-out sample IDs.
Same-sequence held-out samples do not establish cross-sequence generalization.
Pattern matching, offline compilation, LRU tags and subset comparisons are necessary work; their hardware latency and area are not folded into arithmetic counters.
External PWP request values are not free runtime source-weight reads; full precomputation arithmetic is separately recorded per calibrated model.
Cache budget is shared across base and residual values. Both explicit vector registers, final cross-K accumulators, descriptors and pattern storage are additional state.
Completed residuals are immutable cached copies. Auditing provenance does not grant future knowledge or change admission/replacement.
Wide signed residual range differs from natural binary subset sums; integer-numerator equality does not establish finite hardware word fit or frozen floating-point reassociation equivalence.
No complete TA-on-residual or Comperity cycle comparator is implemented here.
